m.e: Clearly provided to them by a time pirate or some-such.

m.e: Our agreement was made to protect the integrity of our timeline.

m.t: Quantos mais estão a perturbar o fluxo temporal agora?
m.e: How many others are out there disturbing the time stream now?

m.e: The... the timeline is unclear on occasion, constantly in flux.

m.e: I went back in time to change the timeline.

m.t: De maneira nenhuma. Tens de manter a linha temporal intacta.
m.e: You must keep the timeline intact.

m.t: Esta é a intersecção mais próxima com a linha temporal do Doutor.
m.e: This is the closest intersection with the Doctor's timeline.

m.t: Estamos presos num loop temporal, e só eu sei disso.
m.e: The time loop. We're trapped in a time loop, and I'm the only one that knows it.

m.t: A assinatura temporal de cada um aqui registrada pelo computador.
m.e: The temporal signature of everyone in the room is logged by the computer.

m.t: O dano no osso temporal direito foi infligido antes da queda da vítima.
m.e: The damage to the right temporal bone was inflicted prior to the victim's fall.

m.e: But we gotta make sure that we don't break any of it
